meta.promptText: Which brand's formal shirts should I buy for men in India?

response.text:
If you're buying **men's formal shirts in India**, I'd shortlist these brands:

- **Van Heusen — best overall**: consistently good for office wear, with polished fits and easy-care options. [midvey.com](https://midvey.com/blogs/news/top-10-best-formal-shirt-brands-in-india-for-2026?utm_source=chatgpt.com)
- **Louis Philippe — best premium choice**: more refined styling and fabric/finish; particularly good for client meetings and senior-professional dressing. [www.indianretailer.com](https://www.indianretailer.com/article/consumer-behaviour/consumer-trends/best-formal-shirt-brands-india?utm_source=chatgpt.com)
- **Arrow — best for classic formal**: crisp, traditional business styling and a more structured look. [midvey.com](https://midvey.com/blogs/news/top-10-best-formal-shirt-brands-in-india-for-2026?utm_source=chatgpt.com)
- **Raymond — best for classic quality/value**: understated designs and good formal versatility. [midvey.com](https://midvey.com/blogs/news/top-10-best-formal-shirt-brands-in-india-for-2026?utm_source=chatgpt.com)
- **Park Avenue — good mid-range option**: professional-looking shirts without going too premium. [couponlap.in](https://couponlap.in/blog/top-shirt-brands-for-men-in-india?utm_source=chatgpt.com)
- **Peter England — best budget option**: useful if you need several shirts for everyday office rotation. [midvey.com](https://midvey.com/blogs/news/top-10-best-formal-shirt-brands-in-india-for-2026?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

### My recommendation

If you want to buy **just 3–5 shirts**, I'd go:

**1. Van Heusen** → everyday office wear  
**2. Louis Philippe** → important meetings/premium look  
**3. Arrow** → classic formal wardrobe

For colours, start with **white, light blue, pale pink, and very light grey**. Prefer solid or very subtle patterns.

If you tell me your **budget per shirt (e.g. ₹1,000 / ₹1,500 / ₹2,500)** and **fit (slim/regular)**, I can find specific shirts currently available in India.
